articles.title: Inside Cardano's 'Van Rossum' hard fork, and what it means for users
articles.snippet: The Van Rossem hard fork moved Cardano to version 11 on Saturday. And for the first time, Cardano's community voted in the upgrade, not the company that built it.

articles.title: Exodus to cut 25% of global workforce in payments shift
articles.snippet: This restructuring is part of a strategy to build a full-stack payments platform following the company's acquisitions of Monavate and Baanx.

articles.title: AI compute stocks bounce as Hut 8, IREN land billions in new contracts
articles.snippet: The deals sparked a rebound in AI compute stocks after investors questioned demand for new data center capacity.

articles.title: Tom Lee's Bitmine slowed ether purchases as it bought back $86 million in stock
articles.snippet: The company added just 7,430 ETH, worth about $14 million, last week as it nears its goal to corner 5% of Ethereum's supply.

articles.title: Bitcoin’s quantum problem gets a recovery tool, but not for Satoshi’s 1.1 million coins
articles.snippet: Project Eleven says it has funded a proof that lets a wallet's own key-derivation path stand in as ownership after quantum computers can forge its signatures. It runs in 243 milliseconds on a laptop.
